name: Akashi Castle
description: Akashi Castle, built 1617-1619 by Ogasawara Tadazane, is one of the few Edo castles with two surviving original turrets (Katsumi & Hitsuji-yagura, national important cultural properties). The castle site is a scenic spot overlooking the Akashi Strait.
notes: Free to enter the park; the two turrets open seasonally and free of charge (check the schedule).

ja.name: 明石城
ja.description: 1617年から小笠原氏が築いた明石城。現存する2基の三重櫓（巽櫓・坤櫓）が国の重要文化財です。
ja.notes: 公園は無料。櫓は季節公開（大人300円）です。
